description:
One collection's lending picture: floor price, open loans, repayment
rate, how much is lent against it (outstanding principal in one currency
and in USD across all, and principal lent all time and over 30 days),
and the principal, APR and remaining-time ranges of its open loans in
that currency. It counts the collection's wrap family together: the
naked collection and the collections that wrap its NFTs one for one
(cryptopunks with wrapped-cryptopunks and cryptopunks-721), whichever
of them the slug names. Any other collection is not included, even one
with a similar name: CryptoPunks V1 (wrapped), official-v1-punks, has
its own stats under its own slug. Use it to answer how much has been
lent against a collection, or to price an offer on it.

currency.description: The chain's wrapped native token if unset.
currency.title: Currency

name: get_collection_lending_stats

outputSchema.description:
The principal and ranges cover the collection's loans in `currency_symbol`,
0 when it has none; the loan count, repayment rate and USD principal cover
every currency.

outstanding_principal.description: Principal of the open loans: what lenders have lent against the collection and not been repaid yet.
outstanding_principal.title: Outstanding Principal

outstanding_principal_usd.description: Principal of the open loans in every currency, valued in USD; a currency without a USD rate adds nothing.
outstanding_principal_usd.title: Outstanding Principal Usd

principal_lent_30d.description: Principal lent against the collection in the last 30 days: every new loan and every refinance adds its principal, so a refinanced loan counts again.
principal_lent_30d.title: Principal Lent 30D

principal_lent_all_time.description: Principal lent against the collection since GONDI began: every new loan and every refinance adds its principal, so a refinanced loan counts again.
principal_lent_all_time.title: Principal Lent All Time

repayment_rate_percent.description: Share of closed loans that were repaid; also 0 while no loan on the collection has closed yet.
repayment_rate_percent.title: Repayment Rate Percent

outputSchema.title: CollectionLendingStats

title: Collection lending stats
